Acceptance:
- Inventory /home/coding/bead-rs/pinned-binaries/ (binaries, *.metadata.json, README.md, BINARY_VERIFICATION.md) and the bead variants in ~/.cargo/bin
- Confirm the versioned naming scheme (<name>-<shaslice>) and identify the exact source binary and commit SHA this pin targets
- Note any gap between current state and the parent acceptance criteria so later children pin against reality, not assumptions
issue.notes:
Split into 4 sequential children (2026-09-02, glm-roam-17): beadrs-6d8e383d (inventory pinned-binaries/) -> beadrs-3d97a9c4 (inventory ~/.cargo/bin variants) -> beadrs-5a3851b3 (naming scheme + pin target) -> beadrs-e6adf893 (gap report onto this bead). Parent blocked by beadrs-e6adf893; umbrella label added. Ground-truth for downstream children: pinned-binaries/ holds 4 binaries (bead-attempt-resolution-e115609; bead-attempt-resolution-f25ab5c = current HEAD pin, commit f25ab5c91c09a3408f23b9cdf2f3e95e81abc060; bead-pre-attempt-resolution; bead-pre-feature) and 5 metadata files - bead-metadata.json breaks the <name>.metadata.json pairing; aggregates: README.md, COMMITS.md, BINARY_VERIFICATION.md, commits.json, bead-release-metadata.json. ~/.cargo/bin: bead (stale 0.2.5 e081639-dirty), bead-pre-resolution-v0.1.3 (embeds 0.2.6 946a727-dirty), bead-with-resolution-v0.2.0 (embeds 0.2.6 1123184-dirty) - the <name>-v<semver> filename scheme matches neither the embedded versions nor the repo scheme <name>-<shaslice>. INCIDENT: beadrs-5a3851b3 was closed twice (18:42:26Z, 18:55:40Z) with no notes/comments/assignee; re-closure coincided with glm-roam-18 dispatch completion; reopened both times, now rev 5 open. If found closed again with no recorded evidence, reopen.

GAP REPORT - pinned-binary state vs this umbrella's acceptance (recorded by beadrs-e6adf893, 2026-09-02T20:02:05Z, glm-face). Reconciles beadrs-6d8e383d's artifact table (its rev 5 notes), beadrs-3d97a9c4's variant table (bead still empty; facts re-verified live this session), and beadrs-5a3851b3's scheme verdict (found closed a THIRD time at rev 6 / 19:06:25Z with no notes/comments/assignee; REOPENED per the standing instruction in this bead's notes, now rev 7 open - verdict content survives only as the compressed paraphrase in this bead's notes). Baseline non-gap, so the chain knows what NOT to redo: all 4 pinned-binaries/ binaries execute and every metadata binary_sha256 matches the live sha256 (the f25ab5c pin re-hashed this session = 9a8455f25bacf5bc961bd740442fdc1b30a67fb6e38d304c23c97a57cf57b04e); scheme <name>-<shaslice> is confirmed by README.md/COMMITS.md and the two conforming pins. Six gaps; each names the downstream child it constrains.

GAP 1 - Pin target is 102 commits behind HEAD. FACT: the HEAD pin bead-attempt-resolution-f25ab5c (commit f25ab5c91c09a3408f23b9cdf2f3e95e81abc060) is an ancestor of HEAD 7d08577 with 102 commits in f25ab5c..HEAD (twin-lineage merge inflates that count, the lag is real either way); the newest built binary anywhere, /home/coding/target/debug/bead, is 0.2.6 (753b519-dirty), also not HEAD. WHY IT MATTERS: the chain is about to "record build metadata" and "copy the built binary to the versioned location" - treating the existing f25ab5c pin as the deliverable bakes in a stale build, while a fresh build changes the shaslice and must be re-derived, not reused. CONSTRAINS: beadrs-f9cf0a6c (record from a fresh build plus the actual commit), beadrs-07abf9db (new filename <name>-<new-shaslice>, never reuse f25ab5c), beadrs-3c92b8ea (shaslice, recorded commit, and live hash must agree with each other, not with the old pin).

GAP 2 - The scheme verdict is unrecorded; its bead has now been closed hollow three times. FACT: the rev 6 closure (19:06:25Z) carried no notes/comments/assignee, the same shape as the two closures this umbrella already reopened; reopened 19:56:37Z to rev 7 open. WHY IT MATTERS: beadrs-07abf9db and beadrs-3c92b8ea are told to follow "the" scheme - with the verdict living only in this bead's paraphrase they would pin against a summary instead of a cited verdict, exactly the "assumptions, not reality" failure this umbrella exists to prevent. CONSTRAINS: beadrs-07abf9db and beadrs-3c92b8ea (scheme authority); the reopened bead must record its verdict before they dispatch.

GAP 3 - The variant table is likewise unrecorded, though its facts are already consumed downstream. FACT: beadrs-3d97a9c4 sits open at rev 1 with empty notes; live re-verification this session: ~/.cargo/bin/bead = 0.2.5 (e081639-dirty), stale against every other binary; bead-pre-resolution-v0.1.3 embeds 0.2.6 (946a727-dirty); bead-with-resolution-v0.2.0 embeds 0.2.6 (1123184-dirty) - the <name>-v<semver> filenames match neither the embedded versions nor the repo scheme. WHY IT MATTERS: in ~/.cargo/bin the filename-implied version is untrustworthy; anything resolving "the pinned bead" by PATH or by semver suffix gets a binary that is not what the name claims. CONSTRAINS: beadrs-07abf9db (must not extend the semver scheme into pinned-binaries/), beadrs-3c92b8ea (verify by hash + metadata, never by filename).

GAP 4 - Only 2/4 pinned binaries follow <name>-<shaslice>. FACT: bead-attempt-resolution-e115609 and -f25ab5c conform; bead-pre-attempt-resolution and bead-pre-feature are role names with no shaslice (beadrs-6d8e383d table). WHY IT MATTERS: role names are mutable in place - content can change under an unchanged name - so "versioned location" is only true of the shaslice-named pair; a pin placed under a role name cannot satisfy the acceptance as a versioned pin. CONSTRAINS: beadrs-07abf9db (the new pin MUST be <name>-<shaslice>; index should map role-named artifacts to their commits), beadrs-3c92b8ea (stability of role-named files is checkable only through their metadata).

GAP 5 - The index files the pin must update are broken or in flight. FACT (beadrs-6d8e383d, spot-re-verified): bead-metadata.json is an orphan (no same-named binary) AND stale - it records /home/coding/target/debug/bead at 57185704 B / d9bc969f..., while that path now holds 57185624 B / e6c769c3... (753b519-dirty, rebuilt 12:39Z; re-verified this session). bead-release-metadata.json is a second orphan whose record_timestamp (12:25:30Z) predates its mtime (15:17). README.md, COMMITS.md, BINARY_VERIFICATION.md, commits.json are all modified in-tree by sibling beadrs-b6441e82; bead-pre-feature.metadata.json is untracked, the only artifact in the dir without a git home. WHY IT MATTERS: beadrs-07abf9db's acceptance says "index entries (README.md and/or bead-metadata.json) updated" - updating bead-metadata.json as-is would enshrine a wrong hash, and blind-editing the aggregates collides with the sibling's uncommitted edits. CONSTRAINS: beadrs-07abf9db (refresh or retire bead-metadata.json rather than append; stage precise paths; coordinate with beadrs-b6441e82), beadrs-3c92b8ea ("referenceable" must mean the referenced metadata actually resolves to the binary).

GAP 6 - Existing metadata carries wrong non-hash fields that a hash-only verification passes. FACT (beadrs-6d8e383d): bead-pre-attempt-resolution.metadata.json records binary_size_bytes 7340032 (exactly 7 MiB - rounded, not measured) vs actual 7305144, and rust_version 1.85 vs 1.97.1 in every other metadata; bead-attempt-resolution-e115609.metadata.json carries stale build_features "default (attempt-resolution included)" vs default=[] at that commit. CONSTRAINS: beadrs-f9cf0a6c (measure size, do not round; take features from the actual build), beadrs-3c92b8ea (its completeness check must cover the fields a hash cannot see).

Recommended chain order from these gaps: beadrs-3d97a9c4 and beadrs-5a3851b3 record their tables/verdict first (GAPs 2-3), then beadrs-f9cf0a6c records metadata for a FRESH build at current HEAD (GAPs 1, 6), then beadrs-07abf9db pins as <name>-<shaslice> with index repair (GAPs 4-5), then beadrs-3c92b8ea verifies hash, fields, and resolvability (all gaps).

The scheme verdict (GAP 2) is durably recorded on beadrs-5a3851b3, closed at rev 10 (Updated 2026-09-02T20:18:25Z), carrying the full four-way-verified verdict: repo scheme <name>-<shaslice> (README.md:16 + both conforming pins), HEAD pin target f25ab5c91c09a3408f23b9cdf2f3e95e81abc060, twin-lineage alias b0d7840 (tree-identical; canonical identifier is f25ab5c), and the downstream rule: never the <role>-v<semver> form.
